title: Differentiating novel coronavirus pneumonia from general pneumonia based on machine learning
summary: The paper reports a specific 100-patient COVID-19 versus general-pneumonia CT classification, with ReliefF-selected image features and 10-fold classifier evaluation; the single-center small cohort limits transportability. Methods/Results: 73 COVID and 27 general pneumonia cases; CT GGO ROI, 34 texture features, ReliefF selection, bagged-tree/SVM/LR/DT/KNN, tenfold CV; best reported ACC 94.16%, sensitivity 88.62%, specificity 100%, AUC .99.
